Agent A (Correctness + my-oss) confidence calibration:

Review confidence: ~25% chance of a missed correctness bug in my two sections.
Least confident areas: (a) generated tonic/prost code and the streaming RPC lifetimes, which I read only through their call sites; (b) whether jsonwebtoken EncodingKey::from_ec_der(PKCS#8) pairs correctly with DecodingKey::from_ec_der(ring SEC1 point) at runtime -- static reading suggests it does, but I executed nothing; (c) FIDO2 and PKCS#11 code behind feature flags that are off by default, reviewed by reading only.
Would raise confidence if: the suite were actually run. I was read-only and did not invoke cargo, so no finding rests on observed runtime behaviour except the GPG colon-format bug, which I verified against real gpg --with-colons output on this machine.
